It appears to be one of her signature Pokémon, along with {{TP|Zoey|Glameow}}. ==History== [[File:Zoey and Gastrodon.png|thumb|left|250px|Gastrodon and Zoey]] Zoey {{pkmn2|caught}} Gastrodon as a Shellos shortly after the events of ''[[DP034|Buizel Your Way Out Of This!]]''. After failing to catch a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{AP|Buizel}} that {{an|Dawn}} later caught, Zoey was revealed to have stayed in the area around the river to find another {{type|Water}} {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, which turned out to be Shellos. Shellos debuted in ''[[DP041|A Stand-Up Sit-Down!]]'', where it helped its {{pkmn|Trainer}} teach {{an|Dawn}} about [[Double Performance]]s in preparation for the {{ci|Hearthome}} {{pkmn|Contest}}. It created a stunning [[Contest combination|combination]] with its own {{m|Mud Bomb}} attack and {{TP|Zoey|Glameow}}'s {{m|Shock Wave}}. The two later teamed up for Zoey's battle with [[Jessie|Jessilina]]. Their combinations were far better than {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}}'s and {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}}'s and they won the match. Zoey used it in the first round of the Hearthome City Pokémon Contest in ''[[DP049|Dawn's Early Night!]]'', where it teamed up with Glameow yet again in a Double Performance. The combination of their moves impressed the [[Contest Judge]]s and placed Zoey among the eight hard-working [[Pokémon Coordinator]]s that advanced to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]]. It later made a short appearance in ''[[DP078|Pruning a Passel of Pals!]]'', beating a {{p|Mareep}} in the [[Wallace Cup]] allowing Zoey to move on to the next round. In ''[[DP093|Playing The Leveling Field!]]'', it was revealed that Shellos helped win Zoey her third [[Ribbon]]. In ''[[DP174|Last Call — First Round!]]'', it was revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into a {{p|Gastrodon}}. Zoey used it in the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]] of the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]] with Lumineon where they performed with their {{m|Water Pulse}} and {{m|Aqua Ring}} attacks to give a unique appeal. After making it through the round, the two Pokémon were used in Zoey's [[DP175|first round battle]] where once again they won. It was used once [[DP176|again]] in the event with Glameow to secure Zoey's place in the semifinals. ==Personality and characteristics== As a Shellos, it was easily scared, as shown in [[DP041|its debut]] when [[Zoey]] introduced it to {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}. Shellos was particularly intimidated by [[Dawn's Buizel]] due to the way Buizel approached it. When performing, however, Shellos displays its confidence, showcasing its [[move]]s and skills in impressive ways. It appears to be Zoey's second most used Pokémon in a similar way to [[Nando's Kricketune]], even being stated by {{an|Brock}} in ''[[DP155|Double-Time Battle Training!]]'' that it is one of her most reliable Pokémon. ==Appearance== {| style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{water color}}; {{roundy}}; border: 3px solid #{{water color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{water color light}}; {{roundytop|5px}}" | As a Shellos |- style="background:#fff" | [[File:Zoey Shellos.png|220px]] |} ==Moves used== {{anmov/h|water|ground|Zoey {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Shellos Water Pulse|1=Gastrodon Water Pulse|2=Shellos Mud Bomb|3=Shellos Hidden Power|4=Shellos Blizzard}}.png|Using {{#switch: {{#expr: {{#time: U}} mod 5}}|0=Water Pulse
